answers.how: The ball is about 36 px in diameter, giving a scale of 0.21/36 m/px. A quadratic fit to its pre-impact positions gives a speed near 541 px/s at 0.5 s.
The quadratic position fit gives a deceleration magnitude of about 64 px/s². Multiplying by the ball-based scale, 0.21/36 m/px, gives the acceleration magnitude.
The fitted ball trajectory gives a speed near 509 px/s at 1 s. Converted using the 36 px ball diameter and its known 0.21 m diameter.
The pre-impact trajectory has approximately constant deceleration, about 64 px/s². Converted using 0.21/36 m/px.
An upright bowling pin measures about 57 px high: 57 × 0.21/36 ≈ 0.33 m.
The foreground black arched ball-return opening measures about 49 px high: 49 × 0.21/36 ≈ 0.29 m.
